newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore July retail sales rise 3.5 pct on year.
newsitem.headline: Singapore July retail sales rise 3.5 pct on year.

text.p: Singapore's June retail sales index (base 1991) rose 3.5 percent compared to a year ago, state television news said on Thursday.
It quoted the government's Department of Statistics as saying July sales were four percent higher than in June, the highest month-on-month rise for the year.
Total retail sales for the month were worth Singapore $2.0 billion, it added.
It said the growth was partly due to the "Great Singapore Sale" annual price discounts in July.
